card_name: HDFC Bank Platinum Times Credit Card
fee_details:
• 1st Year: Rs.1000
• 2nd Year Onwards: Rs.1000 + Minimum spends of Rs.75,000
reward_structure:
• Dining: Every Rs.150 spent - 750 points
• Other: Every Rs.150 spent - 250 points
key_highlights:
• Get thousands of discount vouchers as a welcome gift
• Enjoy a discount of 50% on movie tickets
• Make use of dining points on more than 100+ partner restaurants with a discount of 7.5%
• Get accelerated reward points on dining weekdays
• The renewal fee is waived if the annual expenditure is more than Rs.2,50,000.

benefits_features.Welcome Benefits: Kickstart your journey of entertainment and relish a broad range of options in apparel, dining, and other various categories offered by the bank.
benefits_features.Movie and Dining Benefits:
• Get wide range of city offers and discounts on movie tickets, online shopping, etc.
• Apart from this, you will get up to 50% off on movie ticket bookings.
• Enjoy a discount of 15% on dining throughout the year with your credit card at partner restaurants.
benefits_features.Fuel Benefits:
• With this credit card, you will also be getting a fuel surcharge waiver of 1% for fuel transactions.
• The maximum waiver per statement cycle is Rs.500.
benefits_features.Insurance Benefits:
• For a minimum of 4 transactions in a month, avail free Accidental Death insurance worth Rs.50lakhs.
• Get theft and burglary protection for goods above Rs.5,000 for 6 months.
• In the case of loss of your card, you need to report it to HDFC Bank [Customer care link].
• Once you report loss, cardholders carry zero liability on any fraudulent transactions.

how_tos.To redeem the credit card points online:
• Login to HDFC credit card or net banking account.
• Select the credit card tab.
• If you registered reward points will appear on the page. If you have not registered, you will need to do so.
• Click on redeem/redemption tab. It will lead you to the redemption portal.
• Once you do, the website will redirect you to the online option and select your Platinum Times Credit card. Click on continue.
• On the homepage, click on "Redeem Reward Points".
• Select the point range from the category to check the catalogues.
• You can select the items you wish to purchase by adding them to the cart.
• Once done, click on "view shopping cart".
• Read the terms and conditions and check the box indicating you have read it.
• Click on "redeem" and note down redemption order number for future references.

reward_point_benefits:
• With the HDFC Bank Platinum Times Credit card, get 15 reward points for every Rs.150 spent.
• Avail accelerated reward points of 750 reward points for every Rs.150 spent on dining during weekdays.
• The reward points will be valid for 2 years from the date of accumulation.

fees_and_charges.Cash advance charges: 2.5% on the withdrawn amount or Rs.500, the higher amount is taken
fees_and_charges.Charges over limit amount:
2.5% on the over limit amount subject to a minimum of Rs.600
• Less than or equal to Rs.100 - Nil
• Rs.100 to Rs.200 - Rs.100
• Rs.200 to Rs.1,000 - Rs.150
• Rs.1,001 to Rs.5,000 - Rs.400
• Rs.5,001 to Rs.10,000 - Rs.750
• Rs.10,001 to Rs.25,000 - Rs.900
• Rs.25,001 to Rs.50,000 - Rs.1100
• More than Rs.50,000 - Rs.1300
fees_and_charges.Late payment charges: 2% of the payment amount subjected to a minimum of Rs.450
fees_and_charges.Balance transfer processing charges: 5% of the balance transfer amount or Rs.250, the higher amount until is taken
fees_and_charges.Fuel surcharge transaction charge: Fuel surcharge is capped at Rs.250 per billing statement cycle
fees_and_charges.Overdue amount processing charge:
If overdue value is up to Rs.2,000 - Rs.25
If overdue value is more than Rs.2,000 - Rs.50
fees_and_charges.Card violation charges - Lounge: Rs.2 and will not be reversed by the bank

miscellaneous: The Platinum Times credit card by HDFC Bank is specially curated for all the movie buffs and the foodies in the country. With this card, you get exclusive discounts on movie ticket booking and dining deals with benefits under different categories as well.

faqs.What is the minimum repayment amount for: Cardholders must make a minimum of 5% of the outstanding balance subject to a minimum of Rs.200.
faqs.How do I make payments for my HDFC credi: Payments can be made in cash, cheques, or at ATMs of any net banking.
faqs.Can HDFC Platinum Times Credit Card be a: Yes, customers can apply for up to 4 add-on cards with a minimum waiver fee.
faqs.Can a HDFC Platinum credit card be used: Yes, this credit card can be used for online transactions after registering with Mastercard SecureCode.
faqs.What are the merchant categories that th: The HDFC Platinum Times credit card can be used at retail stores, travel, cruises, entertainment websites and more.
